tex_content.html:
Proposition

↗ prop:symmetric-bilinear-orthogonal-basis

Every scalar product space has an orthonormal basis.

Proof

↗ prop:symmetric-bilinear-orthogonal-basis ↗ lem:nondegenerate-symmetric-bilinear \sketch Choose a $q$-orthogonal basis $(b_i)$. Nondegeneracy implies $q(b_i,b_i)\ne 0$ for every $i$; otherwise $b_i$ would be orthogonal to the entire basis. Then

\[ e_i=\frac{b_i}{\sqrt{|q(b_i,b_i)|}} \]

is an orthonormal basis.

□
